symbol.description: e.g. TACO -- display only, also used to locate supply/history/<symbol>/ for the genesisSupply fallback

stablePool.description: the POOL address for nativeWrapper/stablecoin (e.g. the WETH/USDG pair), NOT the stablecoin's own token address -- confirmed live 2026-08 that using the token address here makes every eth_call against it revert, since it isn't a Uniswap V2 pair contract. Look it up via the factory's getPair(tokenA, tokenB) if unknown.

genesisSupply.description: falls back to supply/history/<symbol>/ if omitted

burnAddresses.description: used for the 24h burn-flow log filter
